input_policy.text: not extracted in this phase; later use frozen official transcription.csv

audio.pretraining: self-supervised speech representation; no EmotionTalk labels
audio.preprocess: stereo mean, float32 normalization, polyphase resampling 44.1 kHz to 16 kHz
audio.representation: last hidden state temporal mean concatenated with temporal population std

video.pretraining: self-supervised visual representation; no EmotionTalk labels
video.crop: largest OpenCV Haar frontal face with 30% margin; full-frame fallback retained and flagged
video.representation: CLS token frame mean concatenated with frame population std

numeric.deterministic_repeat_gate: max absolute difference must equal 0 on benchmark sample

missingness_policy: No silent imputation. Keep resumable work files and fail final export if any allowed-split key lacks either modality or contains non-finite features.
validation_policy: Feature extraction is label-blind. Validation labels remain unused until the single frozen Phase 19 evaluation.
